statement: UCCI shares the core idea of calibrating confidence and using thresholds for routing, but focuses on LLM cascades using token-margin uncertainty and isotonic regression, whereas the proposed idea generalizes to any diverse set of models with post-hoc calibration and common thresholds across models.

evidence.quote: We present UCCI, a calibration-first router that maps token-level margin uncertainty to a per-query error probability via isotonic regression and selects the escalation threshold by constrained cost minimization.
